terrain.sampling: bilinear DEM; south-to-north rows, west-to-east columns

limitations: OSM footprint/tenant positions are mapped observations; independent survey accuracy unverified.
Facade designs, glass displays, heights without OSM tags, street furniture and planting are interpreted, not photographed replicas.
Storefront/arrival points inferred from nearest footprint edge; current entrance and tenant boundaries require a site survey.
No exact shop interiors. Fictional visitors and authored conversations, not real residents or store staff.
No live Jev inference verified without configured credentials. No UE or target-GPU 4K performance proof.
